# Relational physics

**We conjecture that physical reality is generated by relating.** Geometry, matter, quantum amplitudes, observers, and thermodynamic states are not all independently given ingredients. The mathematical program studies the conditions under which they can be articulated and stabilized from relational acts.

The [Turn](../concepts/turn.md) states the generative precedence of kinematic, quantum, causal, and thermodynamic regimes, including its concrete recurrence/Pisot selection conjecture. The [relational arrow of time](relational-arrow-of-time.md) arises from directed distinctions and accumulated histories; the thermodynamic arrow emerges through physical dynamics and coarse-graining.

## States, observables, and conservation

In any specific physical realization, a **state** is an admissible formation of physical relations. An **observable** reads a quantity on such states. **Evolution** transports states in accordance with a specified law. An **invariant** \(I\) satisfies \(I\circ F=I\) for the chosen evolution \(F\).

A symmetry can yield conservation when the hypotheses of a Noether theorem hold—typically a suitable action, smooth variational dynamics, and a continuous symmetry. We study which relational symmetries can generate those physical hypotheses. A general conserved “coherence” is not assumed from the word *relational* alone.

Obsmetrologia contains concrete finite relational and dynamical constructions, including free-energy Lyapunov functions and ledgers with specified gauge actions. Those results concern their declared state spaces. The wider physical conjecture seeks the maps that make their laws observable in the quantum, causal, and thermodynamic fields.

## Curvature and residuals

[Lambek residuation](../concepts/residuation.md) distinguishes left and right conditions under directed composition. We conjecture a transport into physical parallel-transport defect and curvature, mediated by the [twistor-incidence](twistoring.md) and KZ coherence structures. These are mathematical commitments to building a compatible realization, not interchangeable labels for an already defined tensor.

The [physical regime terms](https://github.com/lenticule-science/science-services-section/blob/main/services/natural-science-services-section/services/physical-science-services-section/services/physics-services-section/content/text/glossary/terms/kinematic-space.md) and [Obsmetrologia's foundational preprint](https://github.com/lenticule-science/obsmetrologia/blob/main/docs/preprints/00-generated-relational-foundation.md) carry the downstream mathematical and scientific dependencies.
